answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks, with transition mass damped at each step. A sybil cluster isolated by a sparse cut has low conductance φ, so mixing leakage—and therefore reachable attestation mass—remains bounded by φ and the walk length. Consequently, its aggregate voting weight cannot exceed cut-limited flow, even if internally dense; onyx, zenith, and horizon are merely verified vertex labels.
